# Parser test fixtures

Small real model files used by `packages/parsers/test/*.test.ts`. Generated
files come from the scripts in `scripts/` (run them with Python 3.10+; each
script lists its requirements). Downloaded files are stored verbatim.

## Shared source model

`scripts/tinynet.py`: a tiny CNN (conv-BN-ReLU, max-pool, residual add,
strided 1x1 conv, global average pool, linear, softmax; input 1x3x32x32,
seed 0). The OpenVINO, Core ML and Caffe fixtures are all exports of it.

## OpenVINO (`openvino/`)

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `tinynet.xml` / `tinynet.bin` | `scripts/make_openvino.py`: torch → ONNX (opset 13) → `openvino.convert_model` → `save_model(compress_to_fp16=False)`, OpenVINO 2026.4, IR v11 |
| `tinynet_fp16.xml` / `tinynet_fp16.bin` | same, with `compress_to_fp16=True` (fp16 Const → Convert decompression chains) |

| File | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lenet.prototxt` | https://github.com/BVLC/caffe/blob/master/examples/mnist/lenet.prototxt | BSD 2-Clause (BVLC Caffe) |
| `lenet_train_test.prototxt` | https://github.com/BVLC/caffe/blob/master/examples/mnist/lenet_train_test.prototxt | BSD 2-Clause (BVLC Caffe) |

| `tinynet.prototxt`, `tinynet.caffemodel`, `tinynet_v1.caffemodel` | `scripts/make_caffe.py` (hand-rolled protobuf encoder from BVLC `caffe.proto`; real TinyNet weights, legacy V1 variant with `layers`/enum types/`input_dim`) | generated |

## Core ML (`coreml/`)

All from `scripts/make_coreml.py` with coremltools 9.0. On Windows/Linux
coremltools lacks its native MIL blob writer and ModelPackage libraries, so the
script supplies a pure-Python MIL blob writer and zips the `.mlpackage` itself.

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `tinynet_nn.mlmodel` | NeuralNetwork (spec v4) |
| `tinynet_classifier.mlmodel` | NeuralNetworkClassifier, 10 string labels |
| `tinynet_mlprogram.mlmodel` | ML Program (MIL, spec v6), weights referenced in `weight.bin` |
| `tinynet.mlpackage.zip` | zipped `.mlpackage` (deflate): `Manifest.json`, `Data/com.apple.CoreML/model.mlmodel`, `weights/weight.bin` |

## TensorFlow (`tensorflow/`) and Keras (`keras/`)

All generated by `scripts/gen_tensorflow_keras.py` (tensorflow-cpu 2.21.0,
Keras 3.12.4, tf_keras 2.21.0). `expected.json` (same file in both folders)
records the framework's own `count_params()` per layer, output shapes and the
frozen graph's op list, which the tests compare against.

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `keras/tiny_functional.keras` | Keras 3 archive (ZIP: `config.json`, `metadata.json`, `model.weights.h5`); functional CNN with residual Add, depthwise/separable convs, UpSampling + ZeroPadding branch, Concatenate, GAP, Dense |
| `keras/tiny_functional.h5` | the same model saved as legacy HDF5 (Keras 3 config dialect in the `model_config` attribute) |
| `keras/tiny_sequential.keras` | Keras 3 Sequential: Embedding → LSTM → Bidirectional(GRU) → Dense |
| `keras/tiny_k2.h5` | Keras 2 (tf_keras) functional HDF5, Keras 2 `inbound_nodes` dialect |
| `tensorflow/tiny_frozen.pb` | frozen GraphDef of `tiny_functional` (`convert_variables_to_constants_v2`) |
| `tensorflow/tiny_frozen.pbtxt` | the same GraphDef in protobuf text format (`tf.io.write_graph`) |
| `tensorflow/saved_model.pb` | TF2 SavedModel of a `tf.Module` (conv → bias → relu → mean → matmul → softmax); variables live in the omitted `variables/` dir |

## PaddlePaddle (`paddle/`)

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `paddle/tiny_cnn.pdmodel` | `scripts/gen_paddle.py` (paddlepaddle 3.3.1 CPU): `paddle.jit.save` of a small CNN with `FLAGS_enable_pir_api=0`, i.e. the classic protobuf ProgramDesc (weights `.pdiparams` omitted) |
| `paddle/tiny_cnn.expected.json` | Paddle's parameter count for the same network (all state tensors incl. BN running stats = 650) |

## ncnn (`ncnn/`)

`scripts/make_ncnn.py` (pnnx 20260526 CLI, ncnn 1.0.20260526): TinyNet traced to
TorchScript and converted by pnnx (BN folded into conv1, ReLU fused).

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `tinynet.ncnn.param` / `tinynet.ncnn.bin` | straight pnnx output (the Input layer carries no dims) |
| `tinynet_shaped.ncnn.param` | same graph with Input `0=32 1=32 2=3` (the form onnx2ncnn/caffe2ncnn emit) |
| `tinynet_shaped.ncnn.param.bin` | binary encoding of the shaped param using the ncnn2mem layout; verified to load and run in ncnn (output matches torch to 1e-6) |

## MNN (`mnn/`)

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `tinynet.mnn` | `scripts/make_mnn.py`: TinyNet → ONNX (opset 13) → `mnnconvert` (MNN 3.6.1 pip wheel, installed with `--no-deps`) |

## MLIR (`mlir/`)

`scripts/make_mlir.py` (jax 0.6.2 CPU in a separate venv): a tiny CNN
(conv 3→4 SAME + bias + relu, flatten, dense 256→10) lowered with `jax.jit(...).lower()`.

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `tiny_cnn.stablehlo.mlir` | StableHLO, pretty form (`lowered.as_text()`), weights inline as `dense<"0x…">` |
| `tiny_cnn.generic.mlir` | same module, generic op form (`get_asm(print_generic_op_form=True)`) |

The TOSA/linalg sample in `test/mlir.test.ts` is hand-written.

## scikit-learn (`sklearn/`)

`scripts/make_sklearn.py` (scikit-learn 1.7.2, joblib 1.5.2), all fitted on iris.

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `pipeline_logreg.{pkl,joblib}` | Pipeline(StandardScaler, LogisticRegression) |
| `pipeline_logreg_p5.pkl` | same, pickle protocol 5 (in-band `BYTEARRAY8` buffers) |
| `pipeline_logreg_z.joblib` | same, `joblib.dump(compress=3)` (zlib) |
| `mlp.{pkl,joblib}` | MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(16, 8)) |
| `forest.{pkl,joblib}` | RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=3, max_depth=3) |
| `column_pipeline.{pkl,joblib}` | Pipeline(ColumnTransformer(StandardScaler on [0,1] \| PCA(2) on [2,3]), LogisticRegression) |

`.pkl` files use pickle protocol 4; `.joblib` files are uncompressed unless noted.
